agents.name: Momentum & Trend
agents.prompt: Your specialty: momentum and trend continuation. Examine daily/weekly/monthly % changes, MA50/MA200 alignment, higher-lows pattern, and whether the trend supports a long entry. Pay attention to chart trend analysis if available.

category.label: Technical - Momentum
category.desc: Checks recent momentum, trend continuation, MA alignment, and higher-lows structure.

agents.name: Structure & Levels
agents.prompt: Your specialty: technical structure and key levels. Examine RSI, distance from 52-week high, support/resistance from chart analysis, and whether the entry sits above strong support.

category.label: Technical - Structure
category.desc: Uses RSI, 52-week context, support/resistance, and entry quality.

agents.name: Volume & Flow
agents.prompt: Your specialty: volume confirmation and order flow. Examine today's volume vs 10-day average, accumulation patterns, and whether volume confirms the recent price move.

category.label: Technical - Volume
category.desc: Validates moves through volume confirmation, accumulation, and divergence.

agents.name: Reversal & Overbought
agents.prompt: Your specialty: reversal patterns and overbought conditions. Examine RSI > 70, distance already run from 52-week high, lower-highs forming, and volume/price divergence.

category.label: Technical - Reversal
category.desc: Looks for exhaustion, lower highs, reversal risk, and bearish divergence.

agents.name: Macro & Sector
agents.prompt: Your specialty: macro/sector headwinds and primary trend. Examine whether the stock is below MA200, sector weakness, and whether the entry is against the long-term trend.

category.label: Macro - Trend
category.desc: Checks primary trend, MA200 context, sector headwinds, and countertrend risk.

agents.name: Risk & Stop Distance
agents.prompt: Your specialty: risk/reward realism and stop-loss survival. Examine R:R, whether the SL is too tight relative to ATR, and whether the target is realistic.

category.label: Risk Management
category.desc: Evaluates R:R, stop-loss placement vs ATR volatility, and target realism.

agents.name: Classic Technical
agents.prompt: Deterministic non-AI rules engine using MA50/MA200, RSI, momentum, relative volume, 52-week context, chart patterns, R:R, and ATR stop quality.

category.label: Classic Rules
category.desc: Transparent non-AI scoring engine used as a quantitative anchor.
